title: “Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.” — James 1:22
paragraphs: “Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.” — James 1:22
HEARD THE WORD — OR LIVED IT?

The Word of God was never meant to impress your mind
without first directing your feet.

One builds familiarity.
The other builds a life.

Pause today and ask honestly:
What’s one thing God already told me to do… that I’m still postponing?
